description: The bar chart, titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Stream," compares the runtime performance of different models, with the y-axis representing runtime in seconds ranging from 50 to 400, and the x-axis listing various models including "Our Joint Framework," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude." The chart uses two distinct colors to differentiate between models: a dark green bar for "Our Joint Framework" and light blue bars for "LLM Models." The runtime for "Our Joint Framework" is 77 seconds, which is significantly lower than all the LLM models. The LLM models show higher runtimes, with "ChatGPT" at 190 seconds, "DeepSeek" at 365 seconds, "LLaMA" at 172 seconds, and "Claude" at 243 seconds. The data clearly illustrates that "Our Joint Framework" has a much faster runtime compared to the LLM models, with "DeepSeek" having the highest runtime among the LLMs.
